baseline.method: Independently executed unmodified upstream selected method on exact bundled observations

metric_definition: For each declared group: norm(estimate-reference,2)/norm(reference,2). Complex arrays use the Hermitian Euclidean norm; no phase, scale, shift, crop or magnitude alignment. Mixed-unit parameter components are evaluated separately.
threshold_provenance: Fixed 1e-5 inverse-parity tolerance recorded before local extraction; independent upstream/high-precision reruns and fresh cleaned parity verify a nonzero numerical tolerance. No reference is physical ground truth.
